# Borah Tour & Travels

> Premier private tour operator and travel specialist for Northeast India (Meghalaya, Tawang / Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Kaziranga National Park) with direct Guwahati airport pickup and custom itineraries.

## Core Services
- **Private Meghalaya Tour Packages:** 1 to 7-day itineraries covering Shillong, Cherrapunji (Sohra), Dawki, Mawlynnong, Nohkalikai, Wei Sawdong, and Nongriat Double Decker Living Root Bridge.
- **Tawang & Arunachal Pradesh Circuits:** 6 to 9-day high-altitude Himalayan tours covering Sela Pass (13,700 ft), Sela Tunnel, Bum La Pass (15,200 ft), Madhuri Lake, Dirang, Sangti Valley, Bomdila, and Shergaon.
- **Assam & Kaziranga Wildlife Safaris:** 1 to 6-day Kaziranga Elephant and Jeep Safaris, Kaziranga Orchid Park, Umrangso Golf Field, Panimur Waterfall, and Guwahati city temple tours.
- **Guwahati Private Transportation & Airport Pickup:** Sedan, SUV, and Tempo Traveler rentals with experienced local mountain drivers.
